structured_output.summary: The diff implements all 17 steps of SharedArrayBuffer.prototype.slice in order, each with its spec comment above the code. Observable operations match the spec: ToIntegerOrInfinity via ToClampedIndex for start, then end (only when not undefined), SpeciesConstructor, Construct with 𝔽(newLength), and the checks at steps 10-13 with the right ? handling. No test-specific branches, no hardcoded values, and no swallowed errors. Errors are propagated with ?. The only only-theoretical extra is a TypeError when a data block is missing, which should be unreachable for a shared buffer. Step 12 compares object identity rather than data blocks; this is equivalent here because each buffer owns its own Vec. The local helpers to_clamped_index and copy_data_block_bytes are written in the file and flagged as not yet in ops, which the ticket allows. The change touches only the one in-scope file.
